title: A friend asked for tips to keep sane while working from...
content: A friend asked for tips to keep sane while working from home. The biggest thing is to trick your brain into treating it like a normal day. Here are 3 ways to do that. (Thread)

title: Keep your morning routine. Get up, shower, have coffee,...
content: Keep your morning routine. Get up, shower, have coffee, watch the news, look at the Internet, do whatever you would normally do before work. Change out of pajamas. Even if that means having “day” sweatpants and “night” sweatpants 😆 (2/4)

title: Don’t work in bed! Bed is for sleeping! Designate a work...
content: Don’t work in bed! Bed is for sleeping! Designate a work space at home. A table, a counter, a specific area that’s JUST for work. So your brain can switch between your “living” space and “working” space. (3/4)

title: Fight the temptation to blur work and personal time. Work...
content: Fight the temptation to blur work and personal time. Work during work hours, take a lunch break if you normally would, and save Instagram and video games for break times or after work hours. Your work will be better for it, and you’ll enjoy your personal time more. (4/4)
